detect_jinja_template_content_format: detect whether a Jinja chat template expects 'string' or 'openai' content format by analyzing its AST
process_content_for_template_format: process a message dictionary's content list based on detected template format and extract multimodal data
try_extract_ast: parse a Jinja chat template string into an abstract syntax tree for further analysis
is_var_access: check if a Jinja AST node represents a variable access like {{ varname }}
is_attr_access: check if a Jinja AST node represents an attribute or item access like {{ varname['key'] }} or {{ varname.key }}
